current_formulation: Note tools write a link one-way in the source note and compute the reverse direction as a backlink list inside one vault or graph.

steps.formulation: The memex writes the link code on both items, so either item recalls the other; links form named trails that can be copied to another person.
steps.quote: on each item these dots by their positions designate the index number of the other item.

steps.formulation: Xanadu keeps links outside the documents, makes them two-way, and treats re-use as a separate connection called transclusion. The date is Nelson's own account of an undocumented 1960 design.
steps.quote: must support bidirectional and profuse links, which cannot be embedded

steps.formulation: Links carry types, and most links have a direction, like an arrow from one structure to another.
steps.quote: most links possessed a direction, i.e., they were like an arrow pointing from one substructure to another

criticism.quote: Yet these systems differ markedly in the specific data models and sets of functionality that they provide to their users.

steps.formulation: The Dexter model stores links in a storage layer apart from component content and addresses link ends through anchors with stable IDs.
steps.quote: Anchors can therefore be uniquely identified across the whole universe by a component UID, anchor id pair.

steps.formulation: The Web link is one-way in the data model; the reverse direction is recovered by a reverse link on write or by back-links gathered in a background process.
steps.quote: A compromise that links be one-way in the data model, but that a reverse link is created when any link is made

criticism.quote: The Web trivialized this original Xanadu model, vastly but incorrectly simplifying these problems to a world of fragile ever-breaking one-way links

steps.formulation: Obsidian writes links one-way in the source note and shows the reverse direction as computed backlinks.
steps.quote: A backlink for a note is a link from another note to that note.
